name: dust

resources.checksum_source: locally-pinned after HTTPS download; not independent upstream verification

notes: Converts the official documented shell installation path with exact patches, pinned version and bundled resources.
Upstream source is fetched from a fixed Git commit at build time rather than vendored. Runtime software license remains upstream.
Creates the explicitly requested install directory before the upstream writability test; otherwise its user-prefix branch incorrectly tries sudo on a new directory.
Fixes reproduced upstream repeat-install Text file busy error by copying to a same-directory temporary binary and renaming over the old executable.
